title: 读指令简史：敌人是不是在偷看你的手柄？

scenes.kicker: 机制拆解 · 第 3 期
scenes.title: 它是不是在读你？

lines.zh: 影之刃零里，隐藏 Boss 新娘阿花，一口气对玩家连放了五次红光投技。
lines.en: In Phantom Blade Zero, the hidden boss Bride Ahua hit one player with five red-flash grabs in a row.

lines.zh: 这段视频在 B 站播放了五十多万次，评论区都在说：它知道你不会躲。
lines.en: The clip passed half a million views on Bilibili. The comments all say: it knows you can't dodge it.
lines.say: 这段视频在 B 站播放了五十多万次，评论区都在说，它知道你不会躲。

lines.zh: 魂游戏里也一样，你刚举起葫芦，弦一郎一枪就捅了过来。
lines.en: Souls games are the same: you raise your gourd, and Genichiro's spear is already coming.

lines.zh: 你有没有想过，它们是不是在偷看你的手柄？
lines.en: Have you ever wondered whether they are peeking at your controller?

lines.zh: 这期机制拆解，把读指令从头讲清楚，最后亲手做一个公平的版本。
lines.en: This time we explain input reading from the ground up, then build a fair version ourselves.

scenes.title: 敌人怎么知道你在干嘛？

lines.zh: 敌人想知道你在干嘛，大概有三种办法。
lines.en: An enemy has roughly three ways to know what you are doing.

lines.zh: 先说一个单位：一帧是六十分之一秒。人看到画面再按键，大概要十五帧。
lines.en: First, a unit: one frame is a sixtieth of a second. Seeing something and pressing a button takes a person about fifteen frames.

lines.zh: 第一种，直接读按键，你按下的那一帧它就知道了。
lines.en: One: read the button. It knows on the very frame you press it.

lines.zh: 第二种，读动作，你的角色一开始出招，系统就通知它。
lines.en: Two: read the action. The moment your character commits, the system tells it.

lines.zh: 第三种，像人一样看画面，看到你抬手，再花零点二五秒反应。
lines.en: Three: watch the screen like a human, see you raise your arm, then take a quarter of a second to react.

lines.zh: 前两种都比人快了十几帧，玩家感受到的，就是被读了。
lines.en: The first two are a dozen-plus frames faster than a person. To the player, that feels like being read.

lines.zh: 最早的读指令，来自街机格斗游戏。
lines.en: The earliest input reading comes from arcade fighting games.

lines.zh: 有人逆向过街霸二的程序，你的招式数据一产生，电脑就能看到，比第一帧画面还早一帧。
lines.en: Someone reverse-engineered Street Fighter II: the CPU sees your move's data the moment it exists, a frame before the first animation frame.

lines.zh: SNK 的 Boss 更夸张，你一出手就被反击，玩家管这叫 SNK 综合征。
lines.en: SNK bosses were worse: counter the instant you move. Players call it SNK Boss Syndrome.
lines.say: S N K 的 Boss 更夸张，你一出手就被反击，玩家管这叫 S N K 综合征。

lines.zh: 到了魂系列，最有名的是喝药惩罚。
lines.en: In the Souls series, the most famous case is the heal punish.

lines.zh: 有 UP 主专门测过只狼的弦一郎：他站着不动的时候，你喝葫芦，他一定突刺。
lines.en: One creator tested Sekiro's Genichiro: if he's standing idle when you drink, he always thrusts.
lines.say: 有 U P 主专门测过只狼的弦一郎，他站着不动的时候，你喝葫芦，他一定突刺。

lines.zh: 法环的玛莲妮亚也一样，看到你喝药就会冲过来。
lines.en: Elden Ring's Malenia does the same: she lunges the moment you heal.

lines.zh: 但有人拆过法环的人工智能脚本，触发它的不是按键，而是你使用道具的动作开始的那一刻。
lines.en: But modders who dug into Elden Ring's AI scripts found the trigger is not the button. It is the moment your item-use action begins.

lines.zh: 所以它读的是你已经承诺的动作，只是快到看不出区别。官方从来没有正式承认过。
lines.en: So it reads an action you have already committed to, just too fast to tell apart. The developer has never confirmed it.

lines.zh: 真正读你硬件的，反而是一九九八年的合金装备。
lines.en: The one that truly read your hardware was Metal Gear Solid, back in 1998.

lines.zh: 心理螳螂会翻你的记忆卡，说出你玩过哪些科乐美游戏，还让手柄自己震起来。
lines.en: Psycho Mantis reads your memory card, names the Konami games you have played, and makes your controller shake by itself.

lines.zh: 打他的办法也很硬件，把手柄换到二号口，他就读不到你了。
lines.en: The fix is hardware too: plug your controller into port two, and he can no longer read you.

scenes.title: 开发中，一切读指令都没用

lines.zh: 那影之刃零呢？
lines.en: So what about Phantom Blade Zero?

lines.zh: 制作人梁其伟在采访里说，开发中完全没有使用读指令。
lines.en: Producer Soulframe Liang said in an interview that they used no input reading at all.

lines.zh: 最高难度逆天者里，Boss 会根据你的行为随机应变；简单模式不削血，而是让敌人反应慢一点。
lines.en: On Hellwalker, bosses adapt to what you do. Easy mode doesn't cut their health; enemies just react slower.

lines.zh: 那新娘为什么偏偏连放红光？B 站 UP 主尾巴尾巴啊做了一期测试，给出了一个解释。
lines.en: Then why does the Bride keep throwing red flashes? Bilibili creator Weiba Weiba tested it and offered an explanation.
lines.say: 那新娘为什么偏偏连放红光？B 站 U P 主尾巴尾巴啊做了一期测试，给出了一个解释。

lines.zh: 他把一个隐藏分显示了出来，称为压力系统：Boss 会评估你的血量、按键频率、喝药和反应速度。
lines.en: He made a hidden score visible and called it the pressure system: the boss rates your health, how fast you press, your healing and your reactions.

lines.zh: 你越慌，分越高；分越高，Boss 越容易放最狠的那几招。
lines.en: The more you panic, the higher the score, and the higher it goes, the more often the boss picks its nastiest moves.

lines.zh: 你狂按闪避，它来剑气；你在喝药，它也来剑气。
lines.en: Mash dodge, and you get a sword wave. Heal, and you get one too.

lines.zh: 游民星空也报道了玩家的发现：你越不会躲哪一招，它就越频繁地出哪一招。
lines.en: Gamersky also reported what players found: whichever move you can't dodge, it uses more and more.

lines.zh: 这些是玩家的实测和推测，不是官方说明。但它解释了一件事：它读的不是按键，而是你的状态。
lines.en: These are player tests and guesses, not official statements. But they explain one thing: it doesn't read your buttons. It reads your state.

lines.zh: 想做一个公平的敌人，可以这样写。
lines.en: Want a fair enemy? Here's how.

lines.zh: 第一，不订阅按键事件，给它一段感知延迟，看到动作以后，等十五帧左右再反应。
lines.en: One: don't subscribe to button events. Give it a perception delay, and after it sees the action, wait about fifteen frames before reacting.

lines.zh: 前摇比反应时间长的招，它能躲开；比反应时间短的快招，它就躲不掉。
lines.en: Moves with longer wind-up than its reaction time get dodged. Faster moves land.

lines.zh: 第二，用你的状态给招式加权：血量低、乱按、喝药，都会让狠招的权重变高。
lines.en: Two: weight its moves by your state. Low health, button mashing and healing all raise the weight of its nastiest moves.

lines.zh: 难度高低，就是调这段延迟、进攻欲望和这张权重表。
lines.en: Difficulty is just tuning that delay, its aggression and that weight table.

lines.zh: 我们把三种敌人做成了能玩的网页：读按键、读动作、看画面。
lines.en: We built all three enemies into a playable page: button reader, action reader, screen watcher.

lines.zh: 同一刀砍过去，你能清楚地感觉到哪一个在作弊。
lines.en: Swing the same slash, and you can clearly feel which one is cheating.

lines.zh: 感谢几位 UP 主的实测和素材，名字和出处都写在画面和简介里。
lines.en: Thanks to the creators whose tests and clips we used. Their names and links are on screen and in the description.
lines.say: 感谢几位 U P 主的实测和素材，名字和出处都写在画面和简介里。

lines.zh: 如果这期对你有帮助，求一个一键三连，再点个关注。
lines.en: If this helped, please like, coin and favourite, and hit follow.

lines.zh: 你被哪个 Boss 读得最狠？评论区告诉我，机制拆解下期见！
lines.en: Which boss read you the hardest? Tell me in the comments. See you next time on Mechanic Breakdown!
